{{Quote|You seem a little lost. Talk to Radeld Siwar. He'll show you the ropes.|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] to a young smuggler|<ref name="SWG:WotS" />}}
'''Radeld Siwar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] that lived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He could often be found in the [[Mos Eisley Combat Hall]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|We do what jobs we're given. No questions asked. It would be a good job to start out with. I want you to go out there and steal whatever they have.|Radeld Siwar|<ref name="SWG:WotS" />}}
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] smuggler [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] asked him to show a young smuggler the ropes of their profession.<ref name="SWG:WotS" /> Siwar decided to first send the smuggler to investigate a company called [[Bantha Moving and Storage]], a front company for a [[Spice/Legends|spice]] smuggling organization. He asked the inexperienced [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to locate and steal spice samples and recipes from the company that were hidden in the [[Junktown]] near [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]]. The smuggler returned successfully, so Siwar kept him in mind for future tasks.<ref name="SWG:BMaS">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Smuggler|Bantha Moving and Storage|Tatooine}}</ref>

When the [[Skaak Tippers]] started cutting into Siwar's business on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], he contacted the aspiring smuggler again and sent him to that [[Planet/Legends|world]] to teach the bootlegger how experienced smugglers dealed with these kind of problems. The smuggler managed to successfully ambush and kill several Skaak Tipper members near [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] to send the gang a message, convincing Riwar that he could utilize the smuggler's skills to solve another problem with his spice moving operations on Naboo too. His local business was taking a hit due to the local [[Maulers|Mauler gang]] that caused a lot of trouble, leading to heightened activity by the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]]. He sent the smuggler to the [[Mauler Stronghold]], where the young criminal ambushed the Maulers and killed several of them to quiet the gang down for a while. Siwar was very satisfied with the job and paid the smuggler a generous reward.<ref name="SWG:WfR">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Smuggler|Working for Radeld|Naboo}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Radeld Siwar appeared as a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:WotS" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Radeld Siwar was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]]" with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]", a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref> He can be found in Mos Eisley and is part of two quests for players of the smuggler profession.<ref name="SWG:WotS" /> The quests are started by inspecting documents that smugglers receive upon reaching certain player levels.<ref name="SWG:WotS" /><ref name="SWG:WfR" />
